subject: Cutscene playback system (CCutsceneManager, CS files)
overview: GTA:SA cutscenes are driven by SCM script opcodes that load named CS (cutscene) files from ANIM/CUT.IMG. Each CS file bundles an IFP animation container with per-object world-space placement data. CCutsceneObject instances (CCutsceneObject schema, C29) are spawned for each prop and are destroyed when the cutscene ends.

cs_file_format.naming: CS names are referenced from SCM script by string (e.g. "cs1", "intro2"); the manager appends '.CS' and looks up in the IMG TOC

cutscene_object_types.description: Each object in a CS is identified by a model name string. The manager spawns one CCutsceneObject per name. Standard props are 'CJ', 'CAR', named NPCs, etc.

audio_sync.description: Cutscene audio uses the CAECutsceneTrackManager (C20). Audio events are triggered by named track entries embedded in the CS file and played back via the CUTSCENE stream-pak.

skip_mechanism.description: Cutscene skip is handled by the SCM SKIP_CUTSCENE opcode (0x039C) which sets a flag checked by CCutsceneManager::Update. On skip the manager calls StopCutscene immediately.

known_cutscene_count.note: Count of CS entries in ANIM/CUT.IMG TOC; exact count varies between executable builds and language versions.
